sources.title: Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions
sources.surface: ONS territorial, residence and footprint methodology bridge
sources.status: Three official measurement bases and their comparability limits documented
sources.verified_fact: ONS distinguishes territorial, residence/production and footprint/consumption measures and explains that each answers a different question.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a single authoritative scope bridge that prevents national totals on different bases from being compared as if equivalent.

sources.title: Annual statement of emissions for 2024
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.surface: GOV.UK Climate Change Act section 16 corporate report
sources.status: Net UK carbon account and carbon-budget accounting for 2024
sources.verified_fact: The statement explains how the 2024 net UK carbon account is calculated from final territorial statistics and notes that the account remains subject to later inventory revisions.
sources.quality_effect: Adds statutory carbon-account reconciliation without converting national accounting totals into facility or parcel emissions.

sources.title: Emissions and targets for installations registered as hospitals or small emitters, 2021 to 2025
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.status: Installation names, regulators, annual targets and actual emissions through 2025
sources.verified_fact: The workbook lists participating installations and their regulator-assigned targets and actual annual emissions for 2021 to 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds real installation-level emissions and identity crosschecks for lower-emitting ETS participants; geographic parcel matching remains separate.

sources.title: UK ETS Allocation Table for operators of installations
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.surface: GOV.UK official installation allocation notice and workbook
sources.status: Installation free-allocation identities and quantities for 2021 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The table lists each installation's free allocation for the 2021 to 2026 period and records amendments arising from activity-level changes.
sources.quality_effect: Adds operator and installation identity reconciliation; allowance allocation is not an emissions measurement.

sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.surface: GOV.UK current scheme-scope and MRV guidance
sources.status: Current installation, aviation, maritime, HSE and USE scope and reporting obligations
sources.verified_fact: The guidance defines covered activities, regulator responsibility, verified reporting deadlines and lower-emitter thresholds, including HSE and USE provisions.
sources.quality_effect: Adds current scope and monitoring-reporting-verification controls so registry omissions and threshold exclusions are not interpreted as zero emissions.

sources.title: UK Greenhouse Gas Pivot Table 2026 - by Source
sources.surface: Official machine-readable source-basis inventory workbook listing
sources.status: 2026 source-basis pivot workbook listed in the official GHG data catalogue
sources.verified_fact: The official NAEI catalogue lists the 2026 source-basis greenhouse-gas pivot workbook and its next publication cycle.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a machine-readable national source-basis control surface; workbook values were not treated as parcel observations in this run.
